comments.text: Thanks for your explanation of volcanic soil, that the ash releases K P Ca Mg into the soil, which plants can take up. The fertiliy of the soil allows high agricultural productivity and renews against depletion in a positive balance, permitting the growing of food at an order of magnitude allowing high population density. The residents knowingly make a 'Vesuvius pact' with the volcano. The Volcano Watch program is commendable.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Beautifully put, and that "Vesuvius pact" is the bargain in a nutshell: the same ash that threatens the fields is what keeps them fertile. For everyone reading, would you make that trade and live beside a volcano for soil that rich?
